propositions: not_a_bug close without replacement link currently routes to completion verifier, which rejects the close by demanding proof that a nonexistent defect was fixed
not_a_bug disposition verdict returns None when no replacement link exists, causing fall-through to full completion verification instead of deterministic (class, reason) attestation
escalated disposition has the same structural problem: no in-repo defect is fixed, making the verifier unpassable, yet lacks explicit disposition routing

not_a_bug and escalated must be added to REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES with optional replacement-link precedence (REPLACEMENT_SATISFIES_REASON_CLASSES), so --reason is accepted as fallback and verifier routing is skipped
write-side refusal via txn.close_class_refusal must enforce both doors (replacement link or --reason) and refuse the close at txn time rather than routing to completion verifier
signed disposition attestation carrying class+reason must be minted and persisted (store event + manifest) when not_a_bug or escalated closes with reason but no replacement
